snippet.title: NaomiHook Trailer - NO MORE HEROES MOD
snippet.description:
It's finally here! 

Our NO MORE HEROES 1 mod menu 'NaomiHook' has something in it for everyone. Whether you're a speedrunner, casual player, or an absolute purist, explore a menu which includes fixes, new game modes, quality-of-life changes and so much more to expand on NMH1's replay value. And of course, its all free!

Download here: https://github.com/SSSiyan/NaomiHook/releases
Keep up with NaomiHook development and occasional cat retweets here: https://x.com/DarkHarmonixer

BGM: N.M.H. (Action Mix)
